title: Transportation Optimization: Recommendation
summary: Minimize total supplier-to-customer cash distribution cost while satisfying all customer demand and respecting supplier supply and transportation-capacity limits.. Recommendation evidence captured from the governed transportation workflow.

payload.recommendedAction: Approve the optimized cash and logistics distribution plan for the selected planning period. The solution fulfills 480 units of demand across 6 demand locations while respecting supplier supply and transportation-capacity limits. Total optimized distribution cost is 818.75. The plan uses 8 active supplier-customer routes and leaves 90 units of residual transport capacity. Implementation should proceed after operations confirms route availability, cost assumptions, and exception handling.
payload.alternativesConsidered: Retain the current operating allocation, execute a partial allocation using only the lowest-risk routes, or rerun the model after refreshing demand, supply, transport-capacity, and route-cost assumptions. These alternatives preserve operational flexibility but may increase total cost or reduce resilience compared with the validated optimum.
payload.residualRisksAndLimitations: Residual risks include supplier or route unavailability, demand variance, transport-capacity deterioration, route-cost changes, execution overrides, and conditions resembling the Severe Disruption scenario. Monitor these risks against the implementation thresholds and rerun the model when a trigger is breached.
